comment: Hand-maintained benchmark row identity pin (all four measured layers).
No generator, template, manifest, or emitting script may read or write
this file. Update procedure: change the per-language row tables first,
audit the operand binding and op identity against the pinned Intel C
signatures by hand, then edit this file manually to match.
bid128|bid64_mixed|bid128_mixed; op = pinned Intel BID C function
identity; operands = exact operand binding tokens in call order;
(nearest-even passed as a call argument at that layer) |
